source_of_truth: Read by hand: AppDialog.vue wraps UModal but declares a title prop, an open model and a close emit, and restores focus on close. A wrapper with an API and behaviour of its own is the pattern the doctrine asks for; flagging it would be a false positive. Documented with a leading comment and @example.
